# OpenAI developer showcase

> Projects, demos, games, visual experiences, and applications built with OpenAI APIs and Codex.

Use project names, descriptions, products, and technologies to find a relevant implementation example.

## Showcase projects
- [Arcade Bar Landing Page](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/arcade-landing-page): This landing page was generated with Codex + GPT-5.5, using GPT Image 2 for visual assets. It introduces Tilt Signal as a neon arcade and pinball bar with event, food, drink, and game sections. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.5 + GPT Image 2. Models: gpt-5.5, gpt-image-2. Use cases: marketing-sites.
- [Asterism](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/asterism): Asterism is a single-player constellation-building card game created by OpenAI with Codex and GPT-5.6. Players choose a Luminary, place named star cards into constellation diagrams, and satisfy line rules and pattern objectives without exhausting the finite deck across a three-Night run. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: Next.js, React, PixiJS, GSAP. Use cases: games, visual-experience.
- [Backroom Center: Corrupted](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/backroom-center-corrupted): Backroom Center: Corrupted is an atmospheric first-person exploration game built by Thomas Ricouard with Codex and GPT-5.6. A deterministic, continuously streamed maze of server rooms, dark corridors, abandoned offices, spatial machinery sounds, and analog-video artifacts creates an unsettling sense of being lost in an endless data center. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: Three.js. Use cases: games, visual-experience.
- [Biome Lab](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/biome-lab): Biome Lab is a deterministic ecosystem sandbox built with Codex and GPT-5.6. Users tune climate, terrain, water, and species balance, then watch a stylized 3D terrarium and compact trend charts respond. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber. Use cases: data-visualization, visual-experience.
- [Brick Platformer](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/brick-platformer): This platformer game was generated with Codex + GPT-5.5, using GPT Image 1.5 for visual assets. It places the player in a side-scrolling brick city scene with jump timing, platforms, and arcade movement. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.5 + GPT Image 1.5. Models: gpt-5.5, gpt-image-1.5. Technologies: React, TypeScript. Use cases: games.
- [Chatkit.world](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/chatkit-world): This map-based chat was built with the Agents SDK for the back-end and ChatKit for the UI. It lets you explore the world through conversation, and collect badges when you visit new places. Models: gpt-5.1. Products: Agents SDK, ChatKit. Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Python. Use cases: agentic-apps.
- [Codex 101](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/codex-101): Codex 101 began in February 2026 as a fact-based Korean developer resource and grew into a bilingual Korean and English tutorial site for developers who want a practical introduction to Codex. It brings setup, authentication, approval modes, slash commands, AGENTS.md, config, MCP, automation patterns, and workflow guidance into one structured guide. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.3-Codex + OpenAI Docs MCP + Computer Use. Models: gpt-5.3-codex. Products: Codex. Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Use cases: documentation.
- [Codex Modeling Studio](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/codex-modeling-studio): Build and refine 3D scenes alongside Codex. Watch changes as they happen, steer the work, and inspect the scene independently. Built with: Codex and Sites. Technologies: WebAssembly, WebGPU.
- [Codex Pet Arena](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/codex-pet-arena): Codex Pet Arena is a single-player browser game built by Gabriel Chua with Codex, ImageGen, and the hatch-pet skill. Players choose an animated pet, race CPU rivals for glowing Codex tokens across a wide side-scrolling arena, grow as their score rises, and battle through rotating city maps with moving platforms, hazards, power-ups, and a low-gravity Moon. Built with: Codex + ImageGen + hatch-pet. Products: Codex. Technologies: React. Use cases: games, visual-experience.
- [Cold Brew House Landing Page](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/coffee-house-landing-page): This landing page was generated with Codex + GPT-5.5, using GPT Image 2 for visual assets. It presents a cold brew house with a quiet editorial layout, product callouts, and lifestyle imagery. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.5 + GPT Image 2. Models: gpt-5.5, gpt-image-2. Use cases: marketing-sites.
- [Crossword Desk](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/crossword-desk): Build crosswords from a themed word pool, edit their clues, and solve published puzzles in the browser. Built with: Codex and Sites.
- [Cubecade](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/cubecade-rubiks): Rotate a 3D puzzle cube by hand or ask ChatGPT to solve it. Watch queued moves animate on the same cube. Built with: Codex and Sites.
- [E-commerce website](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/e-commerce-website): This storefront was generated with Codex, using `gpt-image-1.5` to generate the visual assets. Try navigating through the different pages and examining product details. The model was only given a style direction for the collection, but came up with all the items and visual design itself. Built with: Codex + gpt-5.4. Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript. Use cases: ecommerce.
- [Enablement Hub](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/enablement-hub): An internal learning hub with featured training, announcements, and a resource grid filtered by role, team, product area, level, format, and freshness. Built with: Sites in Codex. Models: gpt-5.5. Technologies: Vinext. Use cases: internal-tools.
- [Event Planning Hub](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/event-planning-hub): An event planning dashboard with active request triage, event templates, recent playbacks, an upcoming calendar, event health metrics, and policy readiness. Built with: Sites in Codex. Models: gpt-5.5. Technologies: Vinext. Use cases: internal-tools.
- [Field Day](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/field-day): Field Day is an editorial commerce experience built with Codex and GPT-5.6. It pairs a bright product catalog with a tactile picnic-basket builder, gift-set review, and persistent local cart. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: React, TypeScript. Use cases: ecommerce.
- [Fieldwork // 12](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/ko-field-beat-machine): A browser beat machine with 12 voices, a 16-step velocity sequencer, nine groove presets, keyboard and touch pads, sound editing, project save and load, and stereo WAV export. Built with: Codex and Sites.
- [Forged in Silence](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/forged-in-silence): Forged in Silence is a premium ecommerce storefront built with Codex from a researched Vite, React, and React Three Fiber plan. The home page is a scroll-driven 3D experience where a procedurally generated katana, built without Blender or an external 3D model, animates through cinematic sections before continuing into product pages, cart behavior, checkout, custom commission requests, and contact flows. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.4. Models: gpt-5.4. Products: Codex. Technologies: React, Three.js, Vite, GSAP, Lenis. Use cases: ecommerce, visual-experience.
- [Glass Towers](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/glass-towers): Glass Towers is a physics-based browser game built with Codex and GPT-5.6. Players drop varied glass pieces onto a pedestal, balancing shape, mass, and momentum to create the tallest stable sculpture. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Rapier. Use cases: games, visual-experience.
- [Golden Gate Experience](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/golden-gate-flight-experience): This experience was generated with Codex + GPT-5.5. It lets you fly around the Golden Gate Bridge, switch camera views, and tune the scene while exploring the bay. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.5. Models: gpt-5.5. Technologies: React, TypeScript. Use cases: visual-experience.
- [Kiln](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/kiln): Kiln is a tactile ceramics storefront built with Codex and GPT-5.6. It combines an eight-piece catalog and local cart with a draggable 3D cup whose glaze updates instantly. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: React, Three.js, React Three Fiber. Use cases: ecommerce, visual-experience.
- [Launch Cal](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/launch-cal): A monthly product and feature calendar with team, status, surface, risk, and freshness filters plus launch details for checklists, source links, dependencies, go-to-market notes, and blockers. Built with: Sites in Codex. Models: gpt-5.5. Technologies: Vinext. Use cases: internal-tools.
- [London Dream Railway](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/london-train): London Dream Railway is an interactive 3D scene with miniature trains, recognizable London landmarks, moving boats, seasonal modes, an auto tour, train follow mode, and an interactive driver cab. Peter started with an initial Codex generation without skills, then used Computer Use repeatedly to walk through the app, test each area, identify issues, and guide further improvements. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.4 + Computer Use validation. Models: gpt-5.4. Products: Codex, Computer Use. Technologies: Three.js, HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Use cases: visual-experience.
- [Margin Editor](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/margin-editor): Create notes and discuss changes with Codex in the same document. The agent can leave its own comments without impersonating you. Built with: Codex and Sites.
- [Material Lab](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/material-lab): Material Lab is an interactive 3D design tool built with Codex and GPT-5.6. It lets users test materials, tune surface and lighting properties, compare sculptural forms, and save reusable presets locally. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber. Use cases: visual-experience.
- [MiniTown](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/minitown): MiniTown is a cozy city simulation built by Thomas Ricouard with Codex and GPT-5.6. Players place residential, shop, and workspace zones, then watch roads form, buildings grow, residents follow daily routines, vehicles move through town, and the lighting shifts from day to night. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6 + ImageGen + Sites. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Use cases: games, visual-experience.
- [Neon FPS](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/rift-vox): This browser FPS game was generated with Codex + GPT-5.5, with GPT Image 2 used for visual assets. It drops players into a neon arena with locked-down megablock atmosphere, weapon pickups, and fast first-person combat. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.5 + GPT Image 2. Models: gpt-5.5, gpt-image-2. Technologies: React, TypeScript. Use cases: games.
- [Onboarding Hub](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/onboarding-hub): A personalized new-hire dashboard with current progress, suggested meetings, a first-week checklist, and a browsable resource library. Built with: Sites in Codex. Models: gpt-5.5. Technologies: Vinext. Use cases: internal-tools.
- [OpenAI.fm](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/openai-fm): This demo lets you try out the OpenAI text-to-speech voices by selecting a voice and generating the desired text. You can also share presets, and download the generated audio. It uses the `gpt-4o-mini-tts` model to generate the speech. Models: gpt-4o-mini-tts. Products: Speech API. Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript. Use cases: voice-apps.
- [Paper Glider](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/paper-glider): Paper Glider is a 3D flying game built with Codex and GPT-5.6. Players steer a paper airplane through a continuous sequence of warm interiors, collecting rings while avoiding furniture and walls. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: JavaScript, WebGL. Use cases: games, visual-experience.
- [Paperie](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/paperie): A greeting-card canvas where an agent supplies personalized words and artwork while you edit and preview the same design. Choose a template or start from a blank card, then adjust its format, messages, and envelope. Built with: Codex and Sites.
- [Phantasy Codex Adventure](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/phantasy-codex-adventure): Phantasy Codex Adventure is a top-down action RPG built by Thomas Ricouard with Codex and GPT-5.6. It combines procedural exploration, responsive real-time combat, three playable classes, eight biomes, bosses, an endless Survival mode, persistent progress, and a shared leaderboard. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6 + ImageGen. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: React, TypeScript. Use cases: games.
- [Photobooth Demo](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/openai-imagegen-demo): This photobooth demo lets you capture or upload a portrait, choose style presets, and generate multiple edited images with the OpenAI Image API and `gpt-image-2`. It supports streaming partial image generations so users can watch outputs arrive as they render. Models: gpt-image-2. Products: Image API. Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui. Use cases: image-generation.
- [Procedural City Generator](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/procedural-city-generator): This 3D procedural city generator was generated with Codex + GPT-5.5. It lets you adjust layout, density, skyline, and visual parameters to see the city update in real time. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.5. Models: gpt-5.5. Technologies: React, TypeScript. Use cases: creative-tools, visual-experience, data-visualization.
- [Pulse Dashboard](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/pulse-dashboard): An executive dashboard with KPI cards, momentum trends, revenue targets, a metric health table, and an operator-ready lineage drawer. Built with: Sites in Codex. Models: gpt-5.5. Technologies: Vinext. Use cases: data-visualization.
- [Real estate data viz](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/real-estate-data-viz): This app was generated with Codex + GPT-5.4 over multiple turns. It lets you explore real estate data fetched from the French Government MCP server through interactive maps and visualizations. You can filter by different parameters and see average or median market prices for real estate, as well as get past sales in the area and trends. Built with: Codex + gpt-5.4. Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript. Use cases: data-visualization.
- [Realtime Solar System](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/solar-system-demo): This demo lets you talk to a 3D solar system with Realtime speech-to-speech and trigger animations with tool calling. Try asking about different planets, ask questions and see animations get triggered. For example, ask how much land there is on Earth versus water, which volcanoes are the highest on Mars, or what are Jupiter's moons. Models: gpt-realtime. Products: Realtime API. Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, WebRTC, Spline. Use cases: education, visual-experience.
- [Scent Cartography](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/scent-cartography): Scent Cartography is a floral fragrance experience built with Codex and GPT-5.6. It combines six fictional perfumes with a botanical configurator that maps top, heart, and base notes into a custom scent. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: React, TypeScript. Use cases: ecommerce, visual-experience.
- [Sparkboard](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/idea-intake): A collaborative idea intake dashboard with a trending feature, board-status navigation, search and filters, upvote-driven idea cards, and top contributor rankings. Built with: Sites in Codex. Models: gpt-5.5. Technologies: Vinext. Use cases: internal-tools.
- [Sunday Table](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/sunday-table): Keep meal plans, recipes, groceries, and preferences in sync while preserving the changes you make yourself. Built with: Codex and Sites.
- [Swifty Dungeon](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/swifty-dungeon): Swifty Dungeon is a playable native macOS dungeon crawler created end-to-end in Codex with GPT-5.5. It combines a raycast-style first-person viewport, procedural labyrinth floors, turn-based movement and combat, equipment, inventory, item pickups, potions, leveling, animated enemy sprites, sidebars, minimap, HUD controls, and unified logging telemetry. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.5 + ImageGen. Models: gpt-5.5, gpt-image-2. Products: Codex. Technologies: Swift, SwiftUI, SwiftPM, macOS. Use cases: games, visual-experience.
- [Swifty Roguelike](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/swifty-roguelike): Swifty Roguelike is a playable native macOS prototype created with Codex and GPT-5.5. It wraps a classic ASCII roguelike board in a SwiftUI Liquid Glass interface, with procedural rooms, corridors, doors, stairs, water, foliage, turn-based movement, bump-to-attack combat, loot, inventory, leveling, and descendable dungeon floors. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.5 + ImageGen. Models: gpt-5.5, gpt-image-2. Products: Codex. Technologies: Swift, SwiftUI, SwiftPM, macOS. Use cases: games, visual-experience.
- [Terrain Mixer](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/terrain-mixer): Terrain Mixer is a browser-based landscape tool built with Codex and GPT-5.6. A seed and six controls shape an animated 3D terrain, contour map, and movable cross-section in real time. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber. Use cases: data-visualization, visual-experience.
- [The TypewriterWeb Demonstration from 1999](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/typewriterweb): TypewriterWeb shows Codex restoring an early web demo by retrieving archived assets, removing injected archive content, serving the project locally, fixing broken JavaScript and CSS behavior, and polishing the final static experience. The original prompt history could not be recovered from VS Code Codex, so the build notes are reconstructed from process videos in the repository. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.4. Models: gpt-5.4. Products: Codex. Technologies: HTML, JavaScript, Express. Use cases: visual-experience.
- [Theme Park Builder](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/theme-park-builder): This mini-game was generated with Codex + GPT-5.5, using GPT Image 1.5 for visual assets. You can add rides, paths, shops, and scenery to build out a theme park scene. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.5 + GPT Image 1.5. Models: gpt-5.5, gpt-image-1.5. Technologies: React, TypeScript. Use cases: games.
- [Time to Fly](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/time-to-fly): Time to Fly is a cosmic logic puzzle built in Codex with GPT-5.5 and GPT Image 2. Players position planets along fixed orbits and set a rocket's launch angle, then use every planet's gravity to bend the rocket toward a distant galaxy across five increasingly difficult levels. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.5 + GPT Image 2. Models: gpt-5.5, gpt-image-2. Products: Codex. Use cases: games.
- [Tiny Rails Rollercoaster](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/tiny-rails-rollercoaster): Tiny Rails Rollercoaster is a playful 3D coaster simulator built by VB with Codex and GPT-5.6. Players drive a tiny train through a detailed storybook landscape, choosing between assisted, coached, limit-pushing, and Unhinged modes across eight route combinations. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6 + ImageGen. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: Three.js. Use cases: games, visual-experience.
- [Turn-based RPG](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/turn-based-rpg): Play a turn-based RPG where GPT-5.4 drives encounters, combat flow, and story events. Built with: Codex + gpt-5.4. Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript. Use cases: games.
- [Verdant Market](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/verdant-market): A grocery-shopping demo with a searchable catalog of 110 products, product pages, a shared cart, and a checkout preview. Built with: Codex and Sites.
- [WanderNote](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/wandernote): Plan an hourly itinerary and map with an agent, using a sample Notion itinerary as context. Edit or dismiss suggestions, leave comments, and export your trip as a PDF. Built with: Codex and Sites.
- [Watchmaker Landing Page](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/watchmaker-landing-page): This landing page was generated with Codex + GPT-5.5, using GPT Image 2 for visual assets. It presents a luxury watchmaker through a cinematic hero, product storytelling, and premium editorial sections. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.5 + GPT Image 2. Models: gpt-5.5, gpt-image-2. Use cases: ecommerce.
- [Waveform Studio](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/waveform-studio): Waveform Studio is an audio-visual design app built with Codex and GPT-5.6. It combines bundled or locally imported audio with configurable linear and radial waveforms, reusable presets, and React component export. Built with: Codex + GPT-5.6. Models: gpt-5.6. Products: Codex. Technologies: React, JavaScript, Canvas, Web Audio API. Use cases: visual-experience.
- [Webroom](https://developers.openai.com/showcase/webroom): A browser-based photo editor where people and agents collaborate on the same image using WebMCP. Built with: Codex and Sites.
